market_rationale: Macro is mixed: payrolls fell 23k with downward revisions and retail sales dropped 0.6%, yet ISM readings are firm and inflation remains sticky (core CPI 2.5%, PPI 4.7%) with a hawkishly split Fed. Long rates are elevated (10y 4.72%). This favors quality pullback names with strong prior trends and mean-reversion candidates over chasing extended winners; SPY itself is near its 52w high after a strong month.
portfolio_rationale: Favor deep relative pullbacks in quality sectors without briefing evidence of fundamental damage: communications (deepest large-cap relative pullback), regional banks (best quality score, steep curve, positive prior trend), and utilities (defensive with rebounding tape amid soft labor/consumer data). Avoid extended high-vol winners (semis, oil, momentum-adjacent) and fundamentally-impaired losers (long Treasuries, solar).
